title: 运动软件的影响
text: 在现代社会中，很多人开始使用健身软件来管理健康。这些工具能记录每天走多少步，还能提醒我们多喝水。除了记录数据以外，它们还能提供专业的运动计划。很多人觉得有了手机，就不需要去昂贵的健身房。这种方式让锻炼变得简单且方便。然而，过度依赖软件也带来了一些问题。有些人只关心数字，而忽略了身体的真实感受。如果目标太高，压力可能会让人感到疲劳。除了追求结果以外，享受运动的过程同样重要。我们需要明白，软件只是辅助工具，不是唯一的标准。真正的健康来自长期的坚持和合理的休息。如果每天强迫自己完成任务，很容易失去兴趣。最好的习惯应该是根据心情调整强度。建议大家在运动时偶尔放下手机。感受呼吸和心跳，才能体会到锻炼的快乐。这样才能让生活变得更加平衡。

questions.prompt: Besides recording steps, what else can the fitness apps remind users to do, according to the text?
What problem does the text mention about people who only care about the numbers on the app?
options: They ignore their body's real feelings

questions.prompt: What does the text suggest people occasionally do during exercise?
According to the text, what does real/lasting health come from?
According to the text, why might someone using a fitness app feel fatigued?
options: Because their goal is set too high
Because the app doesn't work correctly
Because they don't have a gym membership

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
